scope.note: Sample of 5 URLs, not a full crawl. Raw HTML via seo_probe.py plus rendered DOM from a real browser.

summary: In a real browser the on-page SEO is well built: unique titles and descriptions, one H1, correct canonicals, and Product schema whose price matches the page. The blocker is access. Every HTML page and the store sitemap first serve a bot-challenge that only a JavaScript browser can pass, so crawlers that don't run JavaScript (most AI crawlers and link-preview bots) see an empty page.

findings.label: OBSERVED
findings.message: Bot-challenge page served instead of content to non-JavaScript clients
findings.evidence: /, /collections/all and /sitemap.xml return HTTP 200 with a 509-byte script-only page (window.rbzns); headless Chromium also received the challenge
findings.fix: Ask the platform to allowlist verified search and AI crawlers in the bot shield

findings.label: UNKNOWN
findings.message: Whether verified Googlebot is let through the shield
findings.evidence: The probe ran from a non-Google IP; Search Console data was not available
findings.fix: Search Console > URL Inspection > View crawled page on a product URL

findings.label: OBSERVED
findings.message: All SEO metadata and structured data exist only after JavaScript
findings.evidence: Post-challenge server HTML has no canonical, meta description or JSON-LD; rendered DOM has all of them plus Product, BreadcrumbList, Organization and WebSite

findings.label: OBSERVED
findings.message: Store /sitemap.xml returns a challenge page, not XML
findings.evidence: HTTP 200, text/html, 509 bytes; mirror sitemap on guide.shop.example returns 98 URLs with no challenge
findings.fix: Submit the mirror sitemap in Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools

findings.label: OBSERVED
findings.message: Collection page /christmas has thin server HTML and no meta description
findings.fix: Add 80-150 words of original intro copy per collection

findings.label: VERIFIED
findings.message: Product schema price matches the visible price
findings.evidence: rendered JSON-LD Offer.price 24.99 USD = visible $24.99 on the product page

findings.label: OBSERVED
findings.message: 1 of 49 homepage images has no alt text
